Relative Net Income Growth vs. Tech 15 Peers
One Intel Goals—Operational and ESG Performance. For 2020, there were five One Intel operational goal categories
1. Deliver Financial Commitments. Goals based on 2020 revenue, adjusted gross margin
2. Product Execution. Goals related to key milestones for 2020 and future products, and design excellence
3. Manufacturing Leadership. Goals related to current and future manufacturing processes
4. Big Bets. Business and product goals in areas such as AI, networking/5G, and the intelligent edge
5. Cultural Transformation. Goals related to quantitative improvements in the areas of employee engagement
Environmental. Goals related to increasing our global renewable energy use and water conservation
Diversity & Inclusion. Goals related to global inclusive hiring practices, including manager training
Since 2019, our PSU awards have been equally weighted on two performance metrics
Cumulative EPS growth is measured based on a three-year cumulative EPS growth rate
